# FlatShift — Shift Work Calendar, Clock-In & Overtime Pay Calculator

> FlatShift is a zero-ad, 100% offline shift work calendar, live clock-in timer, and overtime paycheck calculator for nurses, hospital staff, factory rotations, and hourly workers on iOS & iPadOS. It paints 3x12, DuPont, Panama 2-2-3, and 4-on/4-off schedules in seconds, calculates daily 1.5x/2.0x overtime + night differentials + net take-home pay, and exports US Letter/A4 PDF timesheets with a $9.99 one-time buyout option.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Can FlatShift calculate Nurse 3x12 shifts, unpaid breaks, and night differentials together?** Yes! FlatShift computes base hours, automatic unpaid break deductions, daily >8h (1.5x) & >12h (2.0x) overtime, night shift hourly differentials, and estimated tax withholding down to the cent.
- **Does FlatShift show pop-up ads when checking my schedule at 3 AM?** Zero ads ever, plus a one-tap Midnight Dark Mode right on the calendar header designed specifically for night-shift nurses and crew members.
- **Do I need an annual subscription to export PDF timesheets?** No — FlatShift includes a free tier for 1 job & 2 PDFs/month, and offers a $9.99 one-time Lifetime Pro unlock with zero recurring fees.
